description: ⚡️ Express inspired web framework written in Go

latest_release.name: v3.6.1
latest_release.body:
## 🧹 Updates

- Consolidate media-type parameter parsing into internal/mediatype (#4750)
- Fix modernize and revive lint issues (#4759)

## 🐛 Fixes

- Fix client, session, basicauth and other bugs found in the audit (#4752)

## 🛠️ Maintenance

- bump github.com/gofiber/utils/v2 from 2.6.1 to 2.6.2 (#4760)
- bump github.com/klauspost/compress from 1.20.1 to 1.20.3 (#4757)
- bump github.com/molecule-man/go-brrr from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0 (#4758)
- bump the golang-modules group with 3 updates (#4755)
- bump release-drafter/release-drafter from 7.9.0 to 7.10.0 (#4756)
- bump actions/setup-node from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 (#4754)

## 📚 Documentation

- Sync the documentation with the v3.6.0 code (#4751)

**📒 Documentation**: https://docs.gofiber.io/

**💬 Discord**: https://gofiber.io/discord

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gofiber/fiber/compare/v3.6.0...v3.6.1

Thank you @alexandear, @gaby, @ninadsutrave and @ReneWerner87 for making this release possible.

hot_issues.title: 🚀 [Feature]: allow to automatically generate OpenAPI docs based on route details, without additional in-code comments
Implement Fluent Method Chaining for Status and Type Methods Using Generics
Consolidate sanitization/normalization helpers and remove double processing
📝 [Proposal]: Always return immutable string and deprecate the `Immutable` flag
🤗 [Question]: Missing Error Details in Query Parser for Custom Types
v4: stop implementing context.Context on Ctx

detail.readme_excerpt:
Fiber is an Express inspired web framework built on top of Fasthttp, the fastest HTTP engine for Go. Designed to ease things up for fast development with zero memory allocation and performance in mind.
